files.install: Save as %APPDATA%\ghostty\config.ghostty (Windows) or ~/.config/ghostty/config.ghostty, then Orca > Settings > Terminal > Import from Ghostty > Apply Changes.
Keep all three JSON files together, then load this folder with orca plugin dev load and select j3w1 in Appearance for the app, editor and terminal. See ports/orca/README.md.
